settings.label: XP rate
settings.desc: XP multiplier for players and Pals. 1 is normal. The level cap stays at 80.

settings.label: Capture rate
settings.desc: Chance a Pal Sphere catches its target. Higher means fewer wasted spheres.

settings.label: Egg hatch time (hours)
settings.desc: Hours for a Huge Egg to hatch; smaller eggs scale down from it. 0 is near instant, default is 72.

settings.label: Stat points: HP
settings.desc: Lets players spend stat points on HP.

settings.label: Stat points: Attack
settings.desc: Lets players spend stat points on Attack.

settings.label: Stat points: Stamina
settings.desc: Lets players spend stat points on Stamina.

settings.label: Stat points: Carry weight
settings.desc: Lets players spend stat points on Carry Weight.

settings.label: Stat points: Work speed
settings.desc: Lets players spend stat points on Work Speed, which speeds up your own building and crafting.

settings.label: Gathering amount
settings.desc: Size of each batch from trees, rocks and ore nodes. Does not change base pits.

settings.label: Tree and rock HP
settings.desc: Lower breaks them in fewer hits but gives less in total. Keep at 1.

settings.label: Tree and rock respawn
settings.desc: How quickly harvested trees and rocks come back. Guides disagree on which way is faster, so leave at 1.

settings.label: Enemy loot
settings.desc: Loot from defeated Pals and enemies. Higher gives more.

settings.label: Base work speed
settings.desc: Speed of pits, crafting, building and cooking. Each cycle finishes faster; the amount per cycle stays the same.

settings.label: Ranch speed
settings.desc: How fast Ranch Pals produce eggs, wool and milk.

settings.label: Pals per base
settings.desc: Most Pals that can work at one base. Max 50. More Pals means more lag.

settings.label: Bases per guild
settings.desc: How many bases each guild can have. Max 10. More bases means more load.

settings.label: Bases on the whole server
settings.desc: Total bases allowed across the server. Leave as is.

settings.label: Structure cap
settings.desc: How many structures each player can build. 0 means unlimited.

settings.label: Structure cap (second)
settings.desc: A second per-player structure cap. 0 means unlimited.

settings.label: Building HP
settings.desc: Higher makes buildings sturdier.

settings.label: Building damage taken
settings.desc: Lower means buildings take less damage.

settings.label: Building decay
settings.desc: How fast buildings decay. 0 turns decay off.

settings.label: Restrict building areas
settings.desc: On blocks building near fast-travel points and other key spots.

settings.label: Enemy camps near bases
settings.desc: Lets enemy camps spawn near your bases. Keep off.

settings.label: Show builder ID
settings.desc: Shows the builder player ID on structures. Cosmetic only.

settings.label: Player hunger
settings.desc: How fast you get hungry. Lower means slower. 1 is normal.

settings.label: Pal hunger
settings.desc: How fast Pals get hungry. Lower means slower, and fed Pals keep their sanity up.

settings.label: Player stamina drain
settings.desc: Sprinting, climbing and swimming. Lower makes stamina last longer.

settings.label: Mount stamina drain
settings.desc: Flying and riding. Lower means longer flights and rides.

settings.label: Player healing
settings.desc: Your natural healing. Higher heals faster.

settings.label: Player healing while asleep
settings.desc: Your healing while sleeping. Higher heals faster.

settings.label: Pal healing
settings.desc: Pals natural healing. Higher heals faster.

settings.label: Pal healing in Palbox
settings.desc: Pals healing while resting in the Palbox. Higher heals faster.

settings.label: Item weight
settings.desc: Lower lets you carry more. 0 is weightless.

settings.label: Gear wear
settings.desc: How fast gear wears out. Lower makes it last longer.

settings.label: Food spoiling
settings.desc: How fast food spoils. Lower means slower.

settings.label: Fishing difficulty
settings.desc: From 0.1 to 1.0. Lower makes fishing easier.

settings.label: Day speed
settings.desc: How fast daytime passes. Higher means shorter days.

settings.label: Night speed
settings.desc: How fast nighttime passes. Higher means shorter nights.

settings.label: Player damage dealt
settings.desc: Higher means players hit harder.

settings.label: Player damage taken
settings.desc: Lower means players take less damage.

settings.label: Pal damage dealt
settings.desc: Higher means Pals hit harder.

settings.label: Pal damage taken
settings.desc: Lower makes Pals tougher.

settings.label: Death penalty
settings.desc: None drops nothing. Item drops items but not gear. ItemAndEquipment drops everything. All also drops your team Pals.

settings.label: Lose Pals on death
settings.desc: Permanently lose Pals when you die. Keep off.

settings.label: Respawn wait (seconds)
settings.desc: Seconds before you can respawn after dying.

settings.label: Repeat-death penalty
settings.desc: Multiplies the respawn wait after repeated deaths.

settings.label: Penalty time window (seconds)
settings.desc: Survival time that decides when the repeat-death penalty applies. Leave at 0.

settings.label: Hardcore
settings.desc: No respawning at all after death.

settings.label: Hardcore: new character
settings.desc: In Hardcore, lets a dead player make a new character.

settings.label: Friendly fire
settings.desc: Lets teammates damage each other. Keep off.

settings.label: Wild Pal spawns
settings.desc: How many wild Pals spawn, bosses included. 2 gives the boss pairs. Higher means more hitching while flying.

settings.label: Predator bosses
settings.desc: Rampaging red-eyed bosses can replace normal spawns anywhere.

settings.label: Base raids
settings.desc: Enemies attack your bases now and then.

settings.label: Supply drop interval (minutes)
settings.desc: Minutes between meteorite and supply drops. Lower means more often.

settings.label: Pal randomizer
settings.desc: Shuffles which Pals spawn where. None keeps the normal world.

settings.label: Randomizer seed
settings.desc: Seed used by the randomizer. Only matters if the randomizer is on.

settings.label: Random Pal levels
settings.desc: Fully random wild Pal levels when the randomizer is on.

settings.label: Difficulty preset
settings.desc: Old preset. Leave at None; your individual settings decide difficulty.

settings.label: Stay in world after logout
settings.desc: Your character sleeps in place, which keeps that base area active. Log off at your base.

settings.label: Offline penalty
settings.desc: Penalties for offline players. May do nothing in version 1.0.

settings.label: Auto-delete inactive guilds
settings.desc: DELETES a guild bases and base Pals if no member logs in for a while. Keep off!

settings.label: Hours before auto-delete
settings.desc: Only matters if auto-delete is on.

settings.label: Players per guild
settings.desc: Most players in one guild.

settings.label: Guild rejoin wait (minutes)
settings.desc: Wait before rejoining a guild after leaving. 0 means no wait.

settings.label: Inactive leader days
settings.desc: Appears to be the days a guild leader can be inactive before leadership passes on.

settings.label: Leader check interval (seconds)
settings.desc: How often the server checks for an inactive guild leader. Leave as is.

settings.label: Guilds processed at once
settings.desc: Technical. Leave as is.

settings.label: Max players online
settings.desc: Most players on the server at once. Max 32.

settings.label: Fast travel
settings.desc: Turns fast travel on or off.

settings.label: Fast travel: bases only
settings.desc: Limits fast travel to trips between bases.

settings.label: Pick start location
settings.desc: Lets new players choose where they start.

settings.label: Player list in menu
settings.desc: Shows who is online in the pause menu.

settings.label: Join and leave messages
settings.desc: Shows a message when players join or leave.

settings.label: Chat limit per minute
settings.desc: Chat messages each player can send per minute.

settings.label: In-game voice chat
settings.desc: PlayStation party chat is separate and not affected.

settings.label: Voice full-volume distance
settings.desc: Only matters if in-game voice chat is on.

settings.label: Voice fade-out distance
settings.desc: Only matters if in-game voice chat is on.

settings.label: Controller aim assist
settings.desc: Aim assist for controllers.

settings.label: Keyboard aim assist
settings.desc: Aim assist for keyboard and mouse. Does not matter on consoles.

settings.label: Global Palbox: save
settings.desc: Lets players save Pals to the Global Palbox.

settings.label: Global Palbox: load
settings.desc: Lets players bring Pals in from other worlds. Off keeps everyone starting fresh.

settings.label: Allow modded PC players
settings.desc: Does not matter on consoles.

settings.label: PvP
settings.desc: Turns PvP on. The next two must be on as well. Trial feature: turns off missions, and rival guilds can open your chests.

settings.label: Player vs player damage
settings.desc: Players can damage each other.

settings.label: Base Pals defend
settings.desc: Base Pals attack players from other guilds.

settings.label: Loot rival drops
settings.desc: Rivals can grab what you drop on death.

settings.label: Rival base borders
settings.desc: Controls whether other guilds base borders are shown.

settings.label: Champion emblem drops
settings.desc: Killing a player drops a Champion Emblem, for scorekeeping.

settings.label: Emblem item
settings.desc: Which item drops for that.

settings.label: Emblems per kill
settings.desc: How many emblems drop.

settings.label: Map: base emblem counts
settings.desc: Shows each base emblem count on the map.

settings.label: Map: player locations
settings.desc: Shows player locations and emblem counts on the map.

settings.label: Max loose items
settings.desc: Most items allowed on the ground; the oldest are cleaned up first.

settings.label: Items with physics
settings.desc: Loose items that bounce and roll. -1 means unlimited. Lower is lighter.

settings.label: Ground item lifetime (hours)
settings.desc: Hours before an item left on the ground disappears. 0.25 is 15 minutes.

settings.label: Pal tracking distance
settings.desc: How far around each player Pals are sent to consoles (5000 to 15000). Lower means less to draw.

settings.label: Autosave interval (seconds)
settings.desc: Seconds between autosaves. Leave as is.

settings.label: World backups
settings.desc: Rolling world backups. Keep on.

settings.label: Chest refresh (seconds)
settings.desc: Seconds between chest refreshes while one is open. Leave as is.

settings.label: Palbox data check
settings.desc: Technical. Leave as is.

settings.label: Building name cache
settings.desc: Technical. Leave as is.

settings.label: Pal droppings
settings.desc: Pal droppings feature. Leave off.

settings.label: Max Pal droppings
settings.desc: Only matters if Pal droppings are on.

settings.label: Server name
settings.desc: Name your friends search for in Community Servers.

settings.label: Server description
settings.desc: Shown when players select your server. No double quote marks.

settings.label: Join password
settings.desc: Password friends enter to join. Everyone needs the new one if you change it.

settings.label: Admin password
settings.desc: Locked: the Command Center, restarts and welcome messages use it.

settings.label: Crossplay platforms
settings.desc: Locked: PS5 and Xbox must stay in it.

settings.label: Public port
settings.desc: Locked: must match your router's port forwarding.

settings.label: Public IP
settings.desc: Locked: blank means detect automatically.

settings.label: REST API
settings.desc: Locked: the Command Center, restarts and welcome messages need it.

settings.label: REST API port
settings.desc: Locked: never port-forward this one.

settings.label: RCON
settings.desc: Locked: older remote admin tool, not used.

settings.label: RCON port
settings.desc: Locked: not used.

settings.label: Server authentication
settings.desc: Locked.

settings.label: Ban list
settings.desc: Locked: Pocketpair ban list.

settings.label: Region
settings.desc: Locked.

settings.label: Log format
settings.desc: Locked.

settings.label: Co-op switch
settings.desc: Locked: not used by a dedicated server.

settings.label: Co-op party size
settings.desc: Locked: not used by a dedicated server.

settings.label: Blocked technologies
settings.desc: Locked: list of tech that cannot be unlocked.
